name: 75235 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75235 (Dallas) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75235 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75235 (Dallas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 13% of all organizations here have no identified type.
